title: Archives
description: Cold audit events, deploy attempts and pipeline runs move into compressed bundles on this server, so the live database stays small. Bundles can be browsed, verified by restore and put back.
empty: Turn on scheduled archiving, or archive cold rows now.
nothingToArchive: Nothing is old enough to archive.
verifyOk: Bundle verified by restoring it into a scratch database.
restoreDescription: Its rows go back into the live tables. Rows already there are left alone, and restored rows age out again on the next archive run.
deleteDescription: The rows it holds are removed for good. Restore or download it first if you may need them.

policy.title: Retention tiers
policy.description: Hot rows stay in the live database. Archived rows live in bundles. Expired bundles are deleted.
policy.enabledHint: Checks hourly and archives rows older than the hot days below.

dump.title: Full control plane dump
dump.description: The full database dump is the control plane backup above: secrets stay encrypted in it, and its restore drill proves it can be restored.
